name: @dreamteamer/tags
description: The tags convention for a dreamteamer workspace — key:value strings on any record, and the one script that lists the tags already in use.

dreamteamer.title: Tags
dreamteamer.description: How a `tags` field is written on ANY record, and how to find the tags already in use before inventing one. One skill, `working-with-tags`, and no collection: a tag is a free string, lowercase and hyphenated, optionally `key:value` with no space around the colon, and nothing validates it — the collection that used to was deleted after 25 of its 68 values turned out never to have been applied to anything. `python3 .dreamteamer/skills/working-with-tags/bin/tags.py` lists what is in use across every collection. Every module whose descriptors carry a `tags` field depends on this one, so the script the field description points at is always there.
